instruction: Turn on Safe Browsing in Chrome to get warnings before visiting potentially harmful websites.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled":false,"enhanced":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Similar to original task but with slightly different wording. Reuses existing get_enable_safe_browsing getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts safebrowsing settings
Logic correctly checks both 'enabled' and 'enhanced' flags with OR logic - returns true if either form of Safe Browsing is active
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares string result against expected value 'true'
Expected value is semantically correct - 'true' indicates Safe Browsing is enabled
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written to disk before verification
Complete coverage of instruction requirement - verifies Safe Browsing is turned on
Getter implementation is robust with error handling for file reading and JSON parsing
The OR logic (is_enhanced or is_enabled) correctly handles both standard and enhanced Safe Browsing modes
